name: Barrage 1918 Host

securitySheaf.label: Maître d' Probe
securitySheaf.effect: A formal service icon checks the intruder's reservation, persona style, and right to be beyond the dining room.

securitySheaf.label: Wax-Seal Trace
securitySheaf.effect: A red wax seal stamps the reservation book and starts following the route back toward the decker.

securitySheaf.label: Menu-Card Scramble
securitySheaf.effect: Menus, ledgers, and event notes shuffle into historical filler and theatrical tasting notes.

securitySheaf.label: Passive Alert: Velvet Rope Lockdown
securitySheaf.effect: The host gets quietly suspicious. Velvet ropes slide into place and restaurant security may become aware.

encounter.consequence: Passive Alert: Barrage 1918 staff/security may become quietly aware of host intrusion. Notify the GM if unresolved pressure remains at run end.

securitySheaf.label: Brass-Stanchion Tar Baby
securitySheaf.effect: Polished brass stanchions and velvet ropes try to hold the icon in place for a human security response.

securitySheaf.label: Active Security Notification
securitySheaf.effect: Management or private-room security receives an actionable warning that someone is in the staff host.

encounter.consequence: Active Security Notification: restaurant management/security may receive a usable intrusion alert. Notify the GM if this remains unresolved.

sculpting: A prestige war-museum restaurant host: brass fixtures, velvet ropes, campaign maps, antique menu cards, officer-club dining rooms, endorsement plaques, wine ledgers, and locked private-event folders. Secure areas become staff corridors, officer safes, procurement crates, and a camera-wall security cluster.
notes: Green-6 upscale restaurant host for Barrage 1918. Public side contains menus and endorsements. Secure side contains three mundane 1-point paydata stores, security system access, and a hidden private-event planning file labeled Ask GM. Main clue route is tuned at two TN 6 / 2-success checks with default 14 dice, about 49.6% by raw branch-success odds.

nodes.title: Restaurant Grid Outside Barrage 1918
nodes.description: You hover in the polished downtown grid outside Barrage 1918. The host presents a theatrical public dining-room surface and a much quieter staff/management access route behind the maître d' stand.

nodes.title: Public Dining-Room Host
nodes.description: The public sculpting is all polish: candlelit officer-club booths, campaign-map table diagrams, tasting-menu cards, reservation etiquette, and a tasteful amount of theatrical smoke.

nodes.title: Historical-War Tasting Menus
nodes.description: Public menus pair courses and drinks with sanitized historical-war themes: trench supper flights, siege-table desserts, campaign cocktails, ration-box amuse-bouches, and expensive explanations. Flavorful, legal, and not secret.

choices.label: Return to the public dining room

nodes.title: Endorsement Gallery
nodes.description: Critic quotes, influencer plaques, celebrity reservation blurbs, and corporate-host dinner photos shine behind glass. They establish prestige and clientele without exposing private data.

choices.label: Return to the public dining room

nodes.title: Public Private-Dining Packages
nodes.description: The public package page advertises chef's tables, private salons, curated historical menus, and premium wine pairings. Actual guest names, room locks, and event plans live deeper in the staff host.

choices.label: Return to the public dining room

nodes.title: Secure Staff Corridor
nodes.description: Behind the maître d' stand, the Host becomes practical: reservation ledgers, staff notes, wine-cellar locks, security maps, and private-event folders. Pick a target before the host decides you are not on the guest list.

choices.label: Find the hidden private-event planning file
Back out through the reservation surface

nodes.title: Paydata: VIP Spend Ledger
nodes.description: You recover a mundane 1-point paydata store: VIP spending patterns, comp history, private-room deposits, and repeat high-roller habits. Tell the GM you recovered Barrage 1918 VIP spend ledger paydata worth 1 Paydata Point by default.

report.title: VIP spend ledger paydata
report.detail: Mevin recovered mundane Barrage 1918 VIP spend ledger paydata worth 1 Paydata Point by default. Confirm names, dates, and sensitivity with the GM.

choices.label: Log off with VIP spend ledger paydata

nodes.title: Paydata: Rare-Bottle Procurement
nodes.description: You recover a mundane 1-point paydata store: rare-bottle purchases, vendor pressure, historical-menu ingredient sourcing, and black-market-adjacent procurement gossip. Tell the GM you recovered Barrage 1918 procurement paydata worth 1 Paydata Point by default.

report.title: Rare-bottle procurement paydata
report.detail: Mevin recovered mundane Barrage 1918 rare-bottle/procurement paydata worth 1 Paydata Point by default. Confirm vendor names and sensitivity with the GM.

nodes.title: Paydata: Staff Tip-Out Fragments
nodes.description: You recover a mundane 1-point paydata store: staff tip-outs, disciplinary fragments, private-room labor notes, and payroll-adjacent resentment. Tell the GM you recovered Barrage 1918 staff-fragment paydata worth 1 Paydata Point by default.

report.title: Staff tip-out paydata
report.detail: Mevin recovered mundane Barrage 1918 staff tip-out/disciplinary paydata worth 1 Paydata Point by default. Confirm personnel names and sensitivity with the GM.

nodes.title: Security Systems Cluster
nodes.description: You reach the security cluster: private-room camera pointers, kitchen-door locks, reservation terminal hooks, panic-button routing, and a security office alert board. Tell the GM you reached the Barrage 1918 security systems cluster; exact controls and physical coverage are GM-scoped.

report.title: Security systems cluster access
report.detail: Mevin reached Barrage 1918 security systems: private-room cameras, door locks, reservation terminals, panic-button routing, and alert board hooks. Confirm exact physical scope and controls with the GM.

nodes.title: Camera Wall Access
nodes.description: You appear to have access to camera pointers for dining rooms, private salons, service corridors, and possibly the exterior entry. Tell the GM you have camera-wall access and ask which feeds are live, stored, blind, or spoofed.

report.title: Camera wall access
report.detail: Mevin reached Barrage 1918 camera pointers. Confirm live/stored feeds, blind spots, and spoofed coverage with the GM.

nodes.title: Door and Private-Room Locks
nodes.description: You appear to have access to lock status and maybe delayed command hooks for kitchen doors, private salons, wine-cellar gates, and staff corridors. Tell the GM before treating any physical door state as changed.

report.title: Door and private-room lock access
report.detail: Mevin reached Barrage 1918 door/private-room lock controls. Confirm whether access is live control, status-only, or delayed command access with the GM.

nodes.title: Ask GM: Private Event Plans
nodes.description: You find the hidden private-event planning file. It contains event plans, but the specifics are intentionally GM-controlled. Ask GM for specifics: event name, sponsor/client, date, guest/security implications, and why this file was hidden instead of ordinary reservation data.

report.title: Ask GM: private event planning file
report.detail: Mevin found the hidden Barrage 1918 private-event planning file. Ask GM for specifics: event name, sponsor/client, date, guest/security implications, and why the file was hidden.

choices.label: Log off with the private-event file noted

nodes.title: Logoff Route
nodes.description: You back out through reservation ledgers and close the connection. Tell the GM which paydata stores, security systems, and Ask GM event file you reached before leaving.
